name: Phone cinema
summary: A feature film or a brand film shot on a phone. The lens is wide and close. The camera slips into places a big rig cannot reach. Gimbal, clip-on lens and app give a controlled look at small cost.

philosophy.core_thesis: A phone is light, cheap and always present, so a crew of 3 can shoot a feature in real streets and fix the look with an app and a grade.
design_principles: Shoot on a phone with a fixed, manual setting: 24 fps, 1/48 s shutter, low ISO and a locked white balance.
Use the main lens at 24mm to 26mm equivalent, and a clip-on anamorphic adapter for a 2.39:1 crop.
Shoot in log or the highest bit-depth mode, and grade in post to match a cinema look.
Mount the phone on a gimbal at 0.5 to 1.5 m/s, or hold it still on a clamp.
Use available light and small LED panels, and avoid the night noise with a 0.5 to 1 stop push only.
Fix the focus and the exposure on the face and lock them before the take.
Record the sound on a separate lavalier or recorder, and sync it in post.
anti_patterns: The default phone colour with a heavy sharpening
A vertical frame for a cinema release
A sensor crop that digital zooms
Phone microphone sound for the dialogue

composition.framing: A 16:9 or a 2.39:1 frame with a wide lens at 1 to 2 m from the subject; a street or a room fills the edges.
composition.staging_in_depth: 3 planes: a close foreground, the figure and a street behind, with a wide lens that exaggerates depth.
composition.subject_placement: Off the centre at 1/3, with 10% to 20% headroom.

principles.rule: Lock the focus and the exposure on the face.
Crop to 2.39:1 with a clip-on anamorphic lens or in post.
Use the wide lens to put a close object in front of the figure.
principles.value: 3 planes, 1 close object at 10% of the frame

principles.rule: Use one practical source and one small LED fill.
Cut at the pace of the scene and hold each take.

camera_and_movement.movement: A gimbal follow, a low or a tight angle in a small space, a car mount and a handheld walk.
camera_and_movement.support: Gimbal, clamp, small tripod and a car mount
camera_and_movement.camera_height: 0.3 to 1.7 m; low angles are easy

lens_and_format.aspect_ratio: 16:9, 1.85:1 or 2.39:1 (a crop or an anamorphic adapter)
lens_and_format.focal_length: 24mm to 26mm main lens equivalent; 48mm to 77mm for a close-up
lens_and_format.aperture: f/1.5 to f/2.8 (fixed on the phone)
lens_and_format.resolution: 4K at 24 fps in a high bit-depth or log mode
lens_and_format.focus: Deep field on the main lens; a locked focus on the face
equipment: a phone with a log or a pro-res mode

light.quality: Soft, natural and practical light, with a small LED panel for the fill; a clean, even exposure.
light.direction: From a window or a lamp, and from the front or the side for the face.
light.colour_temperature: Daylight 5600K or 3200K lamps, locked on the phone
light.source: Windows, practical lamps and a small LED panel

colour_and_grade.treatment: A clean cinema grade made in post: a neutral colour, a soft contrast and a film-like roll-off on the highlights.
grade_recipe: Convert from log to Rec.709 with a standard LUT.
Set the black point at 3% and roll off the highlights above 90%.
Add grain at 10% to 15% to hide the phone noise.
Add a soft bloom of 5% to 8% on the highlights.
colour_and_grade.texture: Light grain over a clean, small-sensor image

editing_and_rhythm.average_shot_length: 4 to 8 s (estimate; check Cinemetrics for each title)
editing_and_rhythm.shot_length_range: 1 s for a cutaway to 2 min for a long gimbal take
editing_and_rhythm.cutting_logic: Cut at the pace of the scene; use long gimbal takes and small camera positions that a big rig cannot reach.
editing_and_rhythm.transitions: Hard cut, a short dissolve and a fade to black.

sound.approach: Separate sound on a lavalier or a boom, synced in post; a clean room tone.
sound.dialogue: Natural and close; no phone microphone for the main take.
sound.music: A score or a licensed track; a source song in the scene.

titles_and_graphics.treatment: A clean title card and an end card; a small 'Shot on' line in a lower-left card for a brand film.
titles_and_graphics.type: A clean sans-serif in white, 2 to 4 s per card.

shot_primer.opening: Open on a gimbal move or a close, wide-lens shot of a street within the first 10 s.

shot_list.shot: Two people in a small room

positive: shot on a smartphone, cinema look
light film grain over a clean image
low angle in a tight space

emotion.target_response: Immediacy and intimacy: the viewer feels close to the street and the face, and sees how little gear a film needs.

use_cases: brand and product films that show a phone look
indie films and shorts on a low budget
video prompts for a close, wide-lens look
avoid_when: The brief needs a shallow, large-sensor depth of field.
The scene needs a long telephoto lens.

modifiers.how: Keep the phone; crop to 9:16, move the subject to the safe zone and cut at 2 to 4 s.
Keep the digital image and the real rooms; add a strict set of rules for light and sound.

aspect_ratio.note: A crop or an anamorphic adapter gives the wide frame.
